bioconductor_annotationhub_metadata_csv.description: AnnotationHub contributor metadata file: a CSV in inst/extdata/ of a hub package, one row per hub resource, read by AnnotationHubData::makeAnnotationHubMetadata() and loaded into the hub database.
bioconductor_annotationhub_metadata_csv.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_annotationhub_record.description: One AnnotationHub resource as returned by https://annotationhub.bioconductor.org/ahid/<AH id> (pretty-printed JSON from AnnotationHubServer3.0 formatId()). The same data lives in the hub's annotationhub.sqlite3 and is what mcols(<AnnotationHub>) shows in R. Array members (rdatapaths, input_sources) are flattened to 'array[].field' keys whose values are lists, one item per array member.
bioconductor_annotationhub_record.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_bsgenome_description.description: DESCRIPTION file (DCF) of a built BSgenome data package, as shipped in the source tarball on bioconductor.org. Holds the standard R package fields plus the seed's genome fields (organism, common_name or species, genome or provider_version, provider, release_date, source_url).
bioconductor_bsgenome_description.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_bsgenome_seed.description: BSgenomeForge seed file: a DCF (Debian Control File) holding everything forgeBSgenomeDataPkg() needs to build a BSgenome data package. Bioconductor keeps its seeds in BSgenomeForge/inst/extdata/seeds/. Two classes share the format: BSgenomeDataPkgSeed (bare sequences) and MaskedBSgenomeDataPkgSeed (masked packages, with RefPkgname and *files_* fields).
bioconductor_bsgenome_seed.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_chrominfo_ncbi.description: GenomeInfoDb getChromInfoFromNCBI() result as cached in GenomeInfoDb/inst/chrominfo_db/NCBI/<accession>.tab (written by saveChromInfoFromNCBI()). A reformatted NCBI assembly report plus a circular flag. One record per sequence.
bioconductor_chrominfo_ncbi.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_chrominfo_ucsc.description: GenomeInfoDb getChromInfoFromUCSC() result as cached in GenomeInfoDb/inst/chrominfo_db/UCSC/<genome>.tab (written by saveChromInfoFromUCSC()). One record per sequence of a UCSC genome.
bioconductor_chrominfo_ucsc.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_genome_mapping_tbl.description: GenomeInfoDb genomeMappingTbl.csv (inst/extdata/dataFiles/), used by mapGenomeBuilds() and genomeBuilds() to map Ensembl assembly names to UCSC genome builds. One record per Ensembl assembly name. The example is an excerpt (header plus all human and yeast rows).
bioconductor_genome_mapping_tbl.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_registered_ncbi.description: GenomeInfoDb registration file for NCBI assemblies (inst/registered/NCBI_assemblies/<Genus_species>.R): an R script that assigns ORGANISM and ASSEMBLIES (a list with one list per assembly). Read by registered_NCBI_assemblies() and getChromInfoFromNCBI(). One record per assembly; ORGANISM is copied onto every record.
bioconductor_registered_ncbi.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_registered_ucsc.description: GenomeInfoDb registration file for a UCSC genome (inst/registered/UCSC_genomes/<genome>.R): an R script assigning GENOME, ORGANISM, ASSEMBLED_MOLECULES, CIRC_SEQS and optionally FETCH_ORDERED_CHROM_SIZES, NCBI_LINKER and ENSEMBL_LINKER. Read by registered_UCSC_genomes() and getChromInfoFromUCSC(). One record per file; NCBI_LINKER components are flattened to NCBI_LINKER.<name>.
bioconductor_registered_ucsc.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_seqinfo.description: Seqinfo object (Seqinfo package, formerly GenomeInfoDb) written as a table: the columns of as.data.frame(<Seqinfo>). One record per sequence. Seqinfo is an in-memory R object with no official file format; the adapter also reads the text that show(<Seqinfo>) prints.
bioconductor_seqinfo.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

bioconductor_seqlevels_style.description: GenomeInfoDb naming-style table used by seqlevelsStyle() and mapSeqlevels() (GenomeInfoDb/inst/extdata/dataFiles/<Genus_species>.txt). One record per chromosome, giving its name in each naming style plus circular/autosome/sex flags. Only main chromosomes are listed, no scaffolds.
bioconductor_seqlevels_style.maintainer: Bioconductor core team (Seqinfo, GenomeInfoDb, BSgenome, BSgenomeForge: Hervé Pagès; AnnotationHub/AnnotationHubData: Bioconductor Package Maintainer <maintainer@bioconductor.org>)

ena_assembly_xml.description: ENA Browser API assembly record as XML (ASSEMBLY_SET > ASSEMBLY), from https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/browser/api/xml/<GCA>. Assembly facts plus a grouped chromosome list and assembly statistics.
ena_assembly_xml.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_browser_summary.description: ENA Browser API /summary/<GCA> JSON. Same content as the XML in a different shape, plus newAccession (latest version of the chain).
ena_browser_summary.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_portal_assembly.description: ENA Portal API search result=assembly, fields=all, as TSV (format=tsv) or JSON (format=json). One row per assembly version.
ena_portal_assembly.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_portal_sequence.description: ENA Portal API search result=sequence, fields=all, as TSV. One row per INSDC sequence record, including sequence_md5.
ena_portal_sequence.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_refget_metadata.description: ENA CRAM Reference Registry (a GA4GH refget 2.0 server, md5 only) sequence metadata, https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ena/cram/sequence/<id>/metadata. Example files hold one served response per line (JSON Lines).
ena_refget_metadata.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_regions.description: ENA FTP assembly regions file, <GCA>_regions.txt. One row per alternate-locus scaffold and where it sits on a chromosome. Only exists for assemblies with alt loci (human, not yeast).
ena_regions.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_sequence_report.description: ENA FTP assembly sequence report, https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/ena/assembly/GCA_xxx/GCA_xxxxxx/<GCA>_sequence_report.txt. One row per sequence in the assembly.
ena_sequence_report.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_webin_chromosome_list.description: Webin-CLI genome submission chromosome list file (submitter input, not served back). Tab or whitespace separated, no header, 3-4 columns.
ena_webin_chromosome_list.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ena_webin_unlocalised_list.description: Webin-CLI genome submission unlocalised list file (submitter input). Two columns, no header: sequence name and the chromosome it belongs to.
ena_webin_unlocalised_list.maintainer: EMBL-EBI (European Molecular Biology Laboratory - European Bioinformatics Institute), ENA team; INSDC partner of NCBI GenBank and DDBJ

ensembl_chromosomes_tsv.description: ensemblorganisms FTP <assembly path>/<provider>/<genebuild date>/genome/chromosomes.tsv.gz: two columns, sequence name and length, no header, sorted by length (longest first). Column names here are chosen; the file has none.
ensembl_chromosomes_tsv.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_core_meta.description: Core database meta table as dumped on the release FTP (mysql/<db>/meta.txt.gz): tab-separated meta_id, species_id, meta_key, meta_value, MySQL escaping, \N = NULL. The adapter returns one record per species_id; database-wide rows (species_id NULL: schema_type, schema_version, patch) are copied into each record; repeated keys become lists.
ensembl_core_meta.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_core_seq_region.description: Core database sequence tables (seq_region, coord_system, seq_region_synonym + external_db, seq_region_attrib + attrib_type). No adapter: a usable record needs a join across several MySQL dump files. The example files are a derived view we built by joining the real release-116 dumps (one row per toplevel seq_region, LRGs excluded); see README.md.
ensembl_core_seq_region.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_fasta_header.description: Header lines of Ensembl genomic DNA FASTA files. Release FTP style: '>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS COORDSYS:VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND EXC' (EXC is 'REF' or empty with a trailing space). ensemblorganisms FTP style: '>ID SEQTYPE:COORDSYS VERSION:NAME:START:END:STRAND' (no coord system inside the location; non-reference scaffolds end with a trailing space). The format is positional; the field paths are names chosen here, following the Ensembl Slice name parts.
ensembl_fasta_header.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_ftp_species_json.description: ensemblorganisms FTP root species.json: catalog of every genome on the new FTP, keyed by species name then assembly accession. One record per species x assembly. '{species}' and '{accession}' in a path stand for those map keys; the field with the placeholder as its last part holds the key itself.
ensembl_ftp_species_json.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_genome_metadata_db.description: New Ensembl genome metadata database (ensembl_genome_metadata), defined by the SQLAlchemy models in Ensembl/ensembl-metadata-api. Tables genome, assembly, assembly_sequence, sequence_alias, organism. No adapter: no public dump of this database was found; the new metadata API exposes parts of it. Example values are taken from API responses that expose the same column, as noted per field; null where no public value was seen.
ensembl_genome_metadata_db.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_rest_info_assembly.description: REST GET /info/assembly/:species (legacy Ensembl release, rest.ensembl.org). Assembly-level keys of the response; the top_level_region array is split out as ensembl_rest_toplevel_region.
ensembl_rest_info_assembly.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_rest_info_assembly_region.description: REST GET /info/assembly/:species/:region_name; facts about one toplevel sequence. The response does not repeat the region name or species; both are only in the request URL (the example file names carry them).
ensembl_rest_info_assembly_region.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_rest_info_genomes.description: REST GET /info/genomes/:genome_name (same object from /info/genomes/assembly/:accession). Built from the legacy ensembl_metadata database. Without expand=1; expand=1 adds large annotation/compara/variation blocks not covered here.
ensembl_rest_info_genomes.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_rest_toplevel_region.description: Rows of top_level_region inside the REST /info/assembly/:species response; one record per toplevel sequence of the primary assembly (no alt/patch scaffolds, no LRGs). synonyms present only with ?synonyms=1.
ensembl_rest_toplevel_region.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_species_list.description: Per-release species list on the FTP root (release-116/species_EnsemblVertebrates.txt). Tab-separated with a '#name' header row; every data row ends with an extra tab.
ensembl_species_list.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_web_ftplinks.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/ftplinks; one record per dataset directory on ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/ensemblorganisms.
ensembl_web_ftplinks.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_web_genome.description: New Ensembl metadata API genome objects: /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/details, /explain (a subset of details), /api/search/genomes?query= (records = matches[]), and /api/metadata/genomeid?assembly_accession_id= (uses genome_uuid). Nested objects are flattened with '.'.
ensembl_web_genome.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_web_genome_stats.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/stats; nested objects flattened with '.'. Only assembly_stats are about the sequences; the rest are annotation statistics.
ensembl_web_genome_stats.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_web_karyotype.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/karyotype; one record per karyotype region. /top-regions returns the same shape (identical for the two anchor genomes).
ensembl_web_karyotype.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

ensembl_web_region_checksum.description: New Ensembl metadata API /api/metadata/genome/{genome_id}/checksum/{region_name}: a text/plain body holding one MD5 hex digest of the region sequence. No adapter: the body has no identifiers (genome and region are only in the URL). The example files collect the real responses for every karyotype region into one JSON object (region name -> body); that wrapper is ours, not Ensembl's.
ensembl_web_region_checksum.maintainer: Ensembl, EMBL-EBI (European Bioinformatics Institute), Hinxton, UK

fhr_fasta_header.description: FHR YAML embedded at the top of a FASTA file in ;~ comment lines; the checksum covers the whole file
fhr_fasta_header.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_gfa_header.description: FHR YAML embedded at the top of a GFA file in #~ comment lines; the checksum covers the whole file
fhr_gfa_header.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_json.description: FHR metadata as a standalone JSON file (FHR 2.1; the same shape holds FHR 1 and 2.0 records)
fhr_json.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_jsonld.description: FHR JSON-LD: the same record plus the FHR @context and @type keys (rules J1-J9); extension fields are not allowed
fhr_jsonld.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_microdata.description: FHR metadata as HTML microdata (itemtype = raw-main fhr.json URL, data-fhr-type annotations, rules M1-M5); extension fields are not allowed
fhr_microdata.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_refgetstore_sidecar.description: RefgetStore FHR sidecar: gtars FhrMetadata serialized as JSON at <store>/fhr/<seqcol digest>.fhr.json (refgenie's public stores)
fhr_refgetstore_sidecar.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_schemaorg_export.description: One-way schema.org export: the record split into typed nodes (assembly Dataset, metadata record, CreateAction, Observations, Grant, ScholarlyArticle) in an @graph; cannot be read back to FHR
fhr_schemaorg_export.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

fhr_yaml.description: FHR metadata as a YAML file (YAML 1.2 core types that read the same under 1.1, rule R12)
fhr_yaml.maintainer: FAIR-bioHeaders project (David Molik and Adam Wright hold schema authority); sidecar variant: databio (gtars) and refgenie

ga4gh_refget_metadata.description: Refget sequences v2 metadata response for one sequence: GET /sequence/<id>/metadata. Digests, length, and aliases tagged with a naming authority.
ga4gh_refget_metadata.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_sam_header_sq.description: SAM header @SQ lines (reference sequence dictionary), as found in SAM/BAM/CRAM headers and Picard/GATK .dict files. One record per @SQ line; order of lines is meaningful.
ga4gh_sam_header_sq.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_seqcol_level1.description: Refget sequence collection, level 1 representation: one JSON object mapping each attribute name to the digest of its level 2 array. Served by GET /collection/<digest>?level=1.
ga4gh_seqcol_level1.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_seqcol_level2.description: Refget sequence collection, canonical level 2 representation: one JSON object of collated arrays (names, lengths, sequences) plus recommended ancillary attributes. Served by GET /collection/<digest>?level=2.
ga4gh_seqcol_level2.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_seqrepo_metadata.description: biocommons SeqRepo REST metadata for one sequence: GET /seqrepo/1/metadata/<namespace:alias>. Lists every namespaced alias SeqRepo knows for the sequence.
ga4gh_seqrepo_metadata.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_vcf_header_contig.description: VCF header ##contig=<...> lines. One record per contig; order of lines is meaningful (BCF encodes CHROM as an index into this list).
ga4gh_vcf_header_contig.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_vcf_header_reference.description: VCF header file-level lines that name the reference: ##fileformat, ##reference (free text, or structured as EVA writes it) and ##assembly. One record per VCF file.
ga4gh_vcf_header_reference.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

ga4gh_vrs_sequence_reference.description: GA4GH VRS 2.x SequenceReference: the object VRS uses to point at a reference sequence by refget accession. Appears inside SequenceLocation.sequenceReference of every VRS Allele. The adapter collects every SequenceReference found anywhere in a JSON or YAML document.
ga4gh_vrs_sequence_reference.maintainer: GA4GH Large Scale Genomics work stream (refget, VRS via Genomic Knowledge Standards); biocommons (SeqRepo); samtools/hts-specs team (SAM, VCF)

galaxy_api_genome.description: GET /api/genomes/{dbkey} on a Galaxy server: the build's sequence names and lengths (from its .len file).
galaxy_api_genome.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_api_genomes.description: GET /api/genomes on a Galaxy server: JSON array of [display name, dbkey] pairs for every known build.
galaxy_api_genomes.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_api_tool_data.description: GET /api/tool_data/{table} on a Galaxy server: one data table's column names and all its rows (merged from every .loc file). One native record per row.
galaxy_api_tool_data.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_builds_txt.description: builds.txt: the static list of genome builds (dbkeys) Galaxy offers in its dbkey picker. Two TAB-separated columns, no header.
galaxy_builds_txt.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_data_manager_json.description: Data manager output JSON: what a data manager tool writes so Galaxy can add rows to data tables. Paths are relative here; data_manager_conf.xml moves the files and rewrites them to absolute paths. One native record per entry.
galaxy_data_manager_json.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_all_tables.description: IDC PR #88 all_tables YAML (sync/tool_data_table_conf_to_yaml.py): every row of every data table on a server, keyed by table, with the .loc and conf file it came from. One native record per row.
galaxy_idc_all_tables.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_data_managers.description: IDC data_managers.yml (older pipeline): data manager short name to Tool Shed tool id, tags that genomes.yml indexers refer to, and fixed parameters.
galaxy_idc_data_managers.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_genomes.description: IDC genomes.yml (older pipeline): genomes to fetch and the indexers to run. cvmfs_current_managed/cvmfs_managed_genomes.yml uses the same entries inside a list of {genomes: [...]} blocks.
galaxy_idc_genomes.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_refget_json.description: IDC PR #88 json/<unique_build_id>.json (sync/all_fasta_files_to_refget_store.py): seqcol level 0/1/2 digests of one all_fasta FASTA plus its Galaxy aliases.
galaxy_idc_refget_json.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_refget_yaml.description: IDC PR #88 yaml/all_fasta.yml: the same digests for every processed FASTA in one file, keyed by unique_build_id, with a peek at the first sequence instead of the full level 2 arrays.
galaxy_idc_refget_yaml.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_idc_request.description: IDC request file data-managers/<data_table>/<version>.yaml (current pipeline): one data manager run that builds one data table entry. Validated by schemas/request.schema.json.
galaxy_idc_request.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_len.description: .len file: one line per sequence, name TAB length. The __dbkeys__ table points to it (len_path); /api/genomes/{id} reads it.
galaxy_len.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_all_fasta.description: Galaxy all_fasta.loc: one FASTA file per row (data table all_fasta). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
galaxy_loc_all_fasta.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_bowtie2_indexes.description: Galaxy bowtie2_indices.loc: Bowtie2 index basename per row (data table bowtie2_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
galaxy_loc_bowtie2_indexes.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_bwa_mem_indexes.description: Galaxy bwa_mem_index.loc: BWA (0.6+/MEM) index prefix per row (data table bwa_mem_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
galaxy_loc_bwa_mem_indexes.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_dbkeys.description: Galaxy dbkeys.loc (data table __dbkeys__): one dbkey per row with its .len file. TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, name, len_path.
galaxy_loc_dbkeys.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_fasta_indexes.description: Galaxy fasta_indexes.loc: samtools faidx-indexed FASTA per row (data table fasta_indexes). TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path.
galaxy_loc_fasta_indexes.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_loc_rnastar_index2x_versioned.description: Galaxy rnastar_index2x_versioned.loc: STAR index directory per row. TAB-separated, '#' comments, no header; column names come from tool_data_table_conf.xml: value, dbkey, name, path, with_gene_model, version.
galaxy_loc_rnastar_index2x_versioned.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_refgenie_table.description: RefgenieToolDataTable (lib/galaxy/tools/data/__init__.py): a data table with type="refgenie" is filled from a refgenie config instead of a .loc file. Each <field> is a Cheetah template over these variables. Prose/code only: there is no file of these records.
galaxy_refgenie_table.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

galaxy_tool_data_table_conf.description: tool_data_table_conf.xml: declares each data table (name, column names, comment character, the .loc files or refgenie config that fill it). One native record per <table>.
galaxy_tool_data_table_conf.maintainer: Galaxy Project (galaxyproject/galaxy), the IUC (galaxyproject/tools-iuc data managers) and the Intergalactic Data Commission (galaxyproject/idc)

ncbi_analysis_set_defline.description: FASTA definition lines of NCBI's GRCh38 analysis sets (GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38/seqs_for_alignment_pipelines.ucsc_ids/*_analysis_set.fna.gz): UCSC-style name then space-separated TAG:value pairs. The example holds only the '>' lines of the full_analysis_set FASTA.
ncbi_analysis_set_defline.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_assembly_report_header.description: Header comment block ('# Key: value' lines and '## Assembly-Unit' lines) of the FTP file <accession>_<asm_name>_assembly_report.txt. One record per file, assembly level.
ncbi_assembly_report_header.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine
fields: RefSeq assembly and GenBank assemblies identical

ncbi_assembly_report_sequences.description: Tab-separated table of the FTP *_assembly_report.txt: one row per top-level sequence, giving its submitter name, role, chromosome, GenBank and RefSeq accessions, assembly unit, length and UCSC-style name. This is NCBI's main name map across naming styles.
ncbi_assembly_report_sequences.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_assembly_summary.description: FTP assembly_summary_refseq.txt / assembly_summary_genbank.txt (current assemblies) and their _historical twins (replaced and suppressed). One tab-separated row per assembly version, 38 columns.
ncbi_assembly_summary.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_datasets_assembly_report.description: NCBI Datasets v2 genome assembly data report: one JSON object per assembly. Served by GET /genome/accession/{accessions}/dataset_report as a page {reports:[...], total_count}, and inside downloaded data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/assembly_data_report.jsonl (JSON Lines, camelCase keys). Native records here flatten nested objects to dotted snake_case paths; arrays stay whole.
ncbi_datasets_assembly_report.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_datasets_sequence_report.description: NCBI Datasets v2 genome sequence report: one JSON object per top-level sequence of an assembly (chromosomes, organelles, unlocalized/unplaced/alt/patch scaffolds). Served by GET /genome/accession/{accession}/sequence_reports, and in data packages as ncbi_dataset/data/<accession>/sequence_report.jsonl (camelCase).
ncbi_datasets_sequence_report.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_md5checksums.description: FTP md5checksums.txt in each assembly directory: '<md5>  ./<file name>' per file, for the files as served (compressed .gz files are checksummed compressed).
ncbi_md5checksums.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

ncbi_uncompressed_checksums.description: FTP uncompressed_checksums.txt in each assembly directory: md5, crc32 and byte size of each file after decompression. Not described in the FTP README; columns come from the file's own header line.
ncbi_uncompressed_checksums.maintainer: National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine

nfcore_igenomes_config.description: Groovy params.genomes map in an nf-core pipeline's conf/igenomes.config (from the nf-core/tools pipeline template). One record per genome key; the key is the value users pass as --genome. Two syntaxes exist: a map literal (current template, rnaseq, sarek) and a nested config block (methylseq, atacseq, chipseq, AWS-iGenomes example config).
nfcore_igenomes_config.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_igenomes_dict.description: Sequence dictionary served with each iGenomes FASTA (genome.dict; Homo_sapiens_assembly38.dict for GATK builds): SAM header @HD and @SQ lines (SAM spec, hts-specs). One record per @SQ line; @HD values are repeated on each record under '@HD/<tag>' keys.
nfcore_igenomes_dict.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_igenomes_fai.description: FASTA index served with each iGenomes FASTA (genome.fa.fai): samtools/htslib faidx format, 5 tab-separated columns, no header. One record per sequence. Column names are the ones htslib's faidx(5) man page uses.
nfcore_igenomes_fai.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_igenomes_genomesize.description: Illumina iGenomes GenomeSize.xml (Sequence/WholeGenomeFasta/GenomeSize.xml): a <sequenceSizes genomeName=...> root with one <chromosome .../> element per sequence. One record per <chromosome>, with the root genomeName repeated on each record.
nfcore_igenomes_genomesize.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_igenomes_manifest.description: AWS iGenomes file manifest (ngi-igenomes_file_manifest.txt): one s3:// URI per line, one record per file. The adapter splits each URI along the iGenomes layout igenomes/<species>/<source>/<build>/<section>/<subpath>.
nfcore_igenomes_manifest.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_igenomes_readme.description: Annotation/README.txt in some iGenomes builds: free text saying when and from where the annotation was downloaded (and, for some builds, the Ensembl and miRBase release). Prose only; no adapter.
nfcore_igenomes_readme.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

nfcore_references_datasheet.description: nf-core/references asset datasheet: a YAML list, one entry per genome, listing the files (and a few tool values) available for it. Published in nf-core/references-datasheets (igenomes/, genomes/, genomes_source/) and validated by schema_references.json in the nf-core/references pipeline.
nfcore_references_datasheet.maintainer: nf-core community (nf-core/tools template, pipelines, nf-core/references); AWS iGenomes S3 mirror set up by Phil Ewels (SciLifeLab NGI), now maintained by nf-core; underlying data from Illumina iGenomes

refgenie_api_alias.description: refgenie 1.x server alias resolution, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/aliases/{name} (OpenAPI schema AliasResponse): the alias, its genome digest, the seqcol level-2 arrays (names, lengths, sequences) and the FHR sidecar.
refgenie_api_alias.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_api_genome.description: refgenie 1.x server genome record, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/genomes/{digest} (OpenAPI schema GenomeDetailResponse). The genome DB columns (refgenie/db/tables.py GenomePublic) plus the species row and the genome's FHR sidecar under 'fhr'.
refgenie_api_genome.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_api_genome_list.description: refgenie 1.x server genome listing, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/genomes?alias=... (OpenAPI schema PageResponse[GenomeResponse]). One record per genome in 'results'; unlike the detail record it lists every alias of the genome and an asset count, but has no FHR block.
refgenie_api_genome_list.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_api_sequences.description: refgenie 1.x server sequence table, GET https://api.refgenie.org/v4/genomes/{digest}/sequences (OpenAPI schema GenomeSequencesResponse). The adapter gives one record per element of 'sequences'; row fields use their own names (name, length, ...) and the collection fields (digest, n_sequences, total_length, level1.*, collection_aliases) are repeated on every row.
refgenie_api_sequences.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_genome_config.description: Legacy refgenie 0.x genome configuration file (genome_config.yaml, config_version 0.4), read by refgenconf and by Galaxy's 'refgenie' tool data table type. Also accepts the bare 'genomes' block that refgenieserver 0.x serves at /_private_api/genomes/dict. The adapter gives one record per genome/asset/tag; map keys (genome digest, asset name, tag name) appear as {genome}, {asset}, {tag} placeholders in the paths.
refgenie_genome_config.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_registry_genome.description: One genome entry of the refgenie-registry (genomes/<organism>/<name>.yaml), validated by schema/genome.schema.yaml. Each entry is one named sequence collection (one exact set of sequences, pinned by seqcol.digest) plus organism, assembly accession, FASTA download URLs, optional FHR provenance, and registry build instructions.
refgenie_registry_genome.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

refgenie_store_sources.description: RefgetStore build table (refgenie-registry stores/<store>/sources.csv), validated by stores/sources_schema.json. One row per FASTA (or space-separated FASTAs concatenated) to load into a store; each row becomes one sequence collection. Columns beyond the schema's are allowed and differ by store.
refgenie_store_sources.maintainer: Sheffield lab, University of Virginia (refgenie project, github.com/refgenie)

ucsc_api_chromosomes.description: REST API /list/chromosomes: sequence names and lengths of one UCSC database or hub genome; one record per sequence.
ucsc_api_chromosomes.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_api_files.description: REST API /list/files: downloadable files of one UCSC or GenArk genome; one record per file (path, size, time).
ucsc_api_files.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_api_findgenome.description: REST API /findGenome: genome search; one record per match (hgcentral.assemblyList row), keyed by UCSC database name or accession.
ucsc_api_findgenome.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_api_genark.description: REST API /list/genarkGenomes: one record per GenArk assembly hub (hgcentral.genark row).
ucsc_api_genark.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_api_hubgenomes.description: REST API /list/hubGenomes: the genome stanzas of one hub as the browser parsed them (relative paths made absolute); one record per genome.
ucsc_api_hubgenomes.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_chrom_sizes.description: chrom.sizes: two-column tab-separated file of sequence name and length, no header; one record per sequence.
ucsc_chrom_sizes.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_chromalias_table.description: chromAlias database table (goldenPath/<db>/database/chromAlias.txt.gz): one row per alias, giving the UCSC sequence name and which authorities use that alias.
ucsc_chromalias_table.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_chromalias_txt.description: chromAlias.txt: one row per sequence; the '#' header names the naming authority of each column. First column is the name the genome itself uses. An older unlabeled variant ('# sequenceName<TAB>alias names') is read into sequenceName + alias names.
ucsc_chromalias_txt.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_dbdb.description: REST API /list/ucscGenomes: one record per UCSC database genome. Each record is a row of the hgcentral.dbDb table.
ucsc_dbdb.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_genomes_txt.description: Hub 'genome' stanzas, from genomes.txt or from a useOneFile hub.txt; one record per genome. This is where an assembly hub declares its sequence, sizes, alias files and naming authority.
ucsc_genomes_txt.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_hub_txt.description: Track/assembly hub hub.txt: the 'hub' stanza (hub id, labels, contact, pointer to genomes.txt). Track stanzas are not read.
ucsc_hub_txt.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz

ucsc_md5sum.description: md5sum.txt in download directories (GNU md5sum output); one record per file checksum.
ucsc_md5sum.maintainer: UCSC Genome Browser Group, Genomics Institute, University of California Santa Cruz
